description: Implement Transaction History screen, Settings screen, and the unit test suite for all repositories. Also add the build_runner CI step to the README. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 at the source level (both depend on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 only), but is run last so integration verification catches everything together.
steps: Step 1 — Implement mobile/lib/features/transaction_history/history_screen.dart. Replace the stub. Uses a Riverpod FutureProvider that calls transactionsRepositoryProvider.getHistory(). Show: AppBar 'Purchase History'. On loading: LoadingWidget. On error: ProofBuyErrorWidget with retry. On empty list: EmptyStateWidget(icon: Icons.receipt_long, message: 'No purchases yet'). On data: ListView.builder. Each item is a ListTile showing: leading Icon based on status (check_circle green for 'captured', cancel red for 'failed', hourglass_empty amber for 'pending'), title is product name (from historyItem.product?.name ?? 'Unknown product'), subtitle is formatted createdAt date, trailing Text of formatted amount+currency from purchase_record. Tapping a row with status 'captured' navigates to '/transaction/${historyItem.purchaseRecord.id}'.

Step 2 — Implement mobile/lib/features/settings/settings_screen.dart. Replace the stub. Show: AppBar 'Settings'. A ListTile 'Backend URL' with subtitle showing AppConfig.backendUrl (read-only — user cannot change it). A ListTile 'App Version' with subtitle '1.0.0+1' (hardcoded from pubspec, or use package_info_plus if preferred — but do NOT add a new dependency; use a hardcoded string). A ListTile 'Clear local data' with trailing IconButton(Icons.delete_outline) that shows a confirmation AlertDialog 'This will clear all locally cached data. Continue?' with Cancel and Confirm buttons. On Confirm, call SharedPreferences.getInstance() then prefs.clear(). Show a SnackBar 'Local data cleared' on completion.

Step 3 — Write repository unit tests in mobile/test/repositories/shopping_repository_test.dart. Use mocktail to mock Dio (or mock the actual HTTP responses using a Dio mock adapter). Test ShoppingRepository: (1) submitBrief returns ShoppingSession on 200 response with valid JSON. (2) submitBrief throws ValidationException on 422 response. (3) getSession returns ShoppingSession on 200. (4) getSession throws NotFoundException on 404.

Step 4 — Write repository unit tests in mobile/test/repositories/checkout_repository_test.dart. Test CheckoutRepository: (1) createCheckout returns CheckoutCreateResponse with orderId, approvalUrl, purchaseId on 200. (2) captureCheckout returns CheckoutCaptureResponse with verified=true on success. (3) captureCheckout returns CheckoutCaptureResponse with verified=false (not an exception — the backend returns 200 with verified:false for unverified captures).

Step 5 — Update mobile/README.md (create it if it does not exist). Document: (1) Prerequisites: Flutter 3.47.1+, Android SDK with accepted licenses. (2) Setup: `flutter pub get`. (3) Code generation: `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs`. (4) Run on emulator: `flutter run --dart-define=BACKEND_URL=http://10.0.2.2:8000`. (5) Run on device: `flutter run --dart-define=BACKEND_URL=http://<your-machine-ip>:8000`. (6) Build APK: `flutter build apk --debug --dart-define=BACKEND_URL=http://10.0.2.2:8000`. (7) Tests: `flutter test`. (8) Common failures and fixes: Android licenses not accepted → `flutter doctor --android-licenses`; build_runner conflicts → use `--delete-conflicting-outputs`; connection refused in emulator → ensure backend is running and use 10.0.2.2 not localhost.

Step 6 — Final full verification pass. Run the full sequence: `flutter pub get`, `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, `flutter build apk --debug`. All four commands must exit 0. Record the output in the FEAT findings field.

SettingsScreen shows backendUrl from AppConfig and clear data button with confirmation
mobile/README.md exists with build and run instructions
